title: Royal Chamber Escape
description: Match glowing gems and blast obstacles to rescue the stranded young king from dungeon spike traps across escalating puzzle chambers.
controls: Tap or swap matching blocks to trigger combos, clear chamber hazards, and rescue the king before moves run out.

zh-CN.title: 密室消除
zh-CN.description: 经典国王密室营救消除玩法：在机关重重的地牢里连消宝石破除尖刺陷阱，争分夺秒救出被困国王。
zh-CN.controls: 点击或滑动交换相邻宝石触发连消与炸弹，在步数耗尽前清除障碍营救国王。
